name: First-Week Coach
tagline: Seven days of ten-minute lessons that turn a new user into a confident one
description: A first week of onboarding in ten-minute daily lessons. It looks at how you actually work, suggests three assistants worth adding to your setup, and coaches the habits that matter: review routines, approval gates, and connecting outside tools without overexposing them. By day seven it should feel like yours.
author: MichaelGannotti
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
